topic: 2026 Iran-Qatar conflict impact on Ras Laffan LNG production
wiki_text: Background for reviewers (2026-07 sweep): A US/Israel-Iran conflict began 2026-02-28 ('Operation Epic Fury'), and Iran responded with missile/drone barrages on regional US-aligned states including Qatar. Qatar's Ras Laffan Industrial City (host of every unit at QatarEnergy LNG (N), QatarEnergy LNG (S), and the North Field expansion) and Mesaieed were struck; QatarEnergy halted all gas/LNG/condensate production at Ras Laffan on 2026-03-02 following a drone strike, and a further Iranian ballistic-missile barrage on 2026-03-18 caused fires and 'significant damage.' QatarEnergy has stated two of Qatar's 14 LNG trains (combined ~12.8 mtpa, ~17% of exports) and one of two Pearl GTL trains were physically damaged, with repairs expected to take 3-5 years and cost roughly $20bn/year in lost revenue; force majeure was declared on some long-term LNG contracts. Production from undamaged trains began restarting after a ceasefire opened a window from early April 2026, but a restart attempt suffered an internal explosion on 2026-06-21, delaying the recovery of even the undamaged capacity; QatarEnergy has said full operations (undamaged trains) are not expected before roughly end-August 2026, contingent also on Strait of Hormuz shipping-security guarantees (mine-clearance confirmation, war-risk insurance) that were still unresolved as of this batch. The North Field expansion (NFE/NFS) construction was separately suspended for the same period (evacuated rig/barge personnel, halted drilling/platform work) and only began remobilizing after the ceasefire; QatarEnergy maintains NFE's H2-2026 first-LNG target is still 'on track.' Press reporting on which specific trains ('Train 4' and 'Train 6' in generic sequential numbering) were damaged does not cleanly map to GEM's current unit groupings -- see companion qa notes for the best candidate mapping (S(3) 'T6-7' is a near-exact ownership match for 'Train 6'; 'Train 4' is ambiguous between N(2) 'T4-5' and S(2) 'T3-5'). No Status field was changed on any Qatar unit this batch given that ambiguity and GEM's per-unit (multi-train) granularity; this entry is meant to give the human reviewer full context to decide.
